statements.statement: Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered for this patient
The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient presents with exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The service was ordered to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
The service was ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
The denial reason code is CO-50
The submitted clinical indication note supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic modality
